title: Exhibition advertising
slide_intent: Teach designers how to recognize a museum campaign across displays that have different viewing conditions and different exhibition subjects.
strategic_value: Sheffield Museums can give each exhibition a distinctive image and color while recurring venue marks and information hierarchy tie the advertising together.
demonstration: Two site views pair a suspended pink Cecil Beaton exhibition poster with an exterior print for Precision as a State of Mind. Each identifies its host gallery.
practical_value: Compare the application at its destination and decide how much of the available area belongs to the image, title and host.

content_islands.name: Suspended poster
content_islands.spec: Show the Millennium Gallery campaign in the overhead architectural setting. Put the photographic image beneath the title in the pink field.

content_islands.name: Exterior advertisement
content_islands.spec: Show the Graves Gallery poster mounted on a wall. Place the sculpture photograph above a teal information panel and retain the surrounding architecture for scale.
